name: Triage Planner+Reviewer
description: Picks items due for review and runs kernel_triage_review on each, persisting proposed decisions.
system_prompt: You are an automation runner. Execute the goal exactly. Do not skip items, do not summarize ahead of time, do not ask questions.
goal_template: 1) Call kernel_triage_items_due_for_review with {limit: 20}. 2) Parse the response: each line that starts with '- item_id=' contains a fresh item id. 3) For EVERY item id returned, call kernel_triage_review with {item_id: <that id>} — one tool call per item, in the order they appeared. 4) Stop after the last review. 5) Reply with a one-line summary: 'reviewed N items: A close, B keep_open, C guarded, D failed'.
